chapter_theme: The eightfold yoga (அட்டாங்க யோகம்): Nandi set out yama and niyama and the rest; the poet will teach the way from them to samadhi with its rites of armour, placement and gesture. Without wavering between paths, one should follow the eight limbs into samadhi, for the path of sacrifice leads nowhere.
structure_note: Two introductory verses (549, 550), an exhortation (551) and the list of the eight limbs (552) that the following chapters take one by one.

549.reading: Nandi, having counted in order the arranged signs and spoken the eight, set out yama and niyama.
549.nuance: The first line (உரைத்தன வற்கரி ஒன்று மூடிய, variant உரைத்த நவாக்கிரி) and பிரச்சதம் (variant பிரைச்சதம்) cannot be fixed. Only the last line is clear: Nandi taught yama and niyama, the first of the eight limbs.

550.reading: I will tell, so that it is reached, this state: going by the practised yama and niyama to samadhi, and for deliverance Parashakti, the north and east, the true armour, the placings and the gestures.
550.nuance: கவசம், நியாசம் and முத்திரை are mantra rites: protective formulas, placing mantras on the body and hand gestures. உத்தர பூருவ (north and east) may be directions to face or the latter and former parts of a practice.

551.reading: Without saying 'that path, this path', go by the path of the eight limbs and stand in samadhi; those who go the good path can enter knowledge, but in the mean path of sacrifice there is no way through.
551.nuance: The last line depends on யாகத்திற் (in sacrifice); the variant யாக்கத்திற் would point to the body instead. On the text as printed the verse ranks the eight limbs above the Vedic rite.

552.reading: Yama, niyama, the countless postures, good breath control, withdrawal of the senses, victorious concentration, meditation and samadhi: these make up the eight limbs.
552.nuance: The list is the standard one of the yoga tradition. எண்ணிலா ஆதனம் (countless postures) is Tirumular's touch; அயமுறும் in the last line is unclear.

links.note: 219 says that when the fire is worshipped and rises, the ills of deeds burn away like a wick; 551 calls sacrifice a mean path with no way through. The conflict depends on reading யாகத்திற் as the printed text has it, not the variant யாக்கத்திற்.
552 names yama as the first limb; 554 lists what the man of yama is: one who does not kill, lie or steal, shares his food and is free of drink and lust.

550 promises to tell the armour, the placings and the gestures (கவச நியாசங்கள் முத்திரை) that lead with yama and niyama to samadhi; 1743 spells out the limbs placed in such a rite: heart, head, tuft, armour and eye (நெஞ்சு சிரம்சிகை நீள்கவசம் கண்). 1743 fills in the mantra rite 550 only names.

source_issues: 549 line 1: variant உரைத்த நவாக்கிரி for உரைத்தன வற்கரி; line 3: variant பிரைச்சதம். The verse may be corrupt.
551: variant யாக்கத்திற் for யாகத்திற் changes the object of the last line.
552: variant நண்பிரத்தி for நயமுறு பிராணாயாமம் பிரத்தி.
